mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 265.0 signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 265.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and HOUST falling) fails to predict negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns during monetary tightening cycles (as defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to weak consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of high unemployment regime instances (UNRATE > 6.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and housing starts signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS rising and HOUST rising) fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (above 1500.0 thousand units) signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500.0 fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.
